title: Try out
author: Tasha A.
desc: Get ready to challenge yourself with the "Try Out" program, a focused 1-week journey designed for those looking to build strength and enhance muscle definition. Comprising four intense training days, this program features a variety of exercises including Dumbbell Hip Thrusts, Bulgarian Split Squats, and Leg Presses, targeting your glutes, legs, and back. Each workout is structured to maximize your gains, ensuring you push your limits while honing your technique. Perfect for lifters of all levels, this program will empower you to achieve your fitness goals in just one week!
